title: Money-Grabbing Game
body: Used to really enjoy this game until I reached level 15. Reality Bay requires “energy” to play which are used up completely within what feels like just a few taps of the generators. Energy also takes over an hour to fully recharge. As someone who really loved playing this game, it feels like I can spend about 5 minutes on it before I’m forced to quit because I have run out of energy. The game only gives you about 3 opportunities to watch ads and gain +25 energy for the whole day, otherwise you have to use diamonds (which are hard to come by once you reach around lvl 15), pay, or wait over an hour for more. The constant added waiting time for energy makes progressing in the game painfully slow and frustrating. Very disappointed in the money-grabbing aspect of the game as I honestly would prefer to be able to play this game for longer than a handful of minutes every couple of hours without having to pay $2+ bucks.
